item.title: Getting shredded at 47
item.description: Last two days training and nutrition have been so on point. I think adding BCAA’s gave me a little extra go in the gym. Yesterday was back shoulders and arms and did a great hour of cardio today and had energy to spare even in a calorie deficit. Cardio was 30 minutes of intervals (2:00 hard 2:00 easy) on the stairmaster, then 30:00 of easy walking on the treadmill (12% 3mph). Threw in 50 pushups just because . Hope everyone is having a great weekend.
